name: Merchant Coast
summary: Trade and piracy shape the Merchant Coast along the Barrens' eastern shore. Ratchet handles sea trade, while pirates contest the coast.

sections.title: A Gateway for Commerce and Conflict
sections.body: The Merchant Coast runs along the Barrens' eastern edge, where ships link central Kalimdor with the Eastern Kingdoms and Theramore. The Steamwheedle Cartel's neutral port of Ratchet takes cargo from anyone with coin. Southsea Freebooters also haunt the sands and nearby waters, preying on merchant ships and setting up illicit operations along the beaches.

faq.q: Why is it called the Merchant Coast?
faq.answer: The coast takes its name from the profitable trade passing through Ratchet. Steamwheedle merchants carry cargo across the Great Sea to ports throughout Azeroth.

faq.q: What major settlements are on the Merchant Coast?
faq.answer: Ratchet, a neutral goblin port run by Gazlowe, is the coast's main settlement. Farther south, Northwatch Hold is an Alliance stronghold, and Fray Island lies just offshore.

faq.q: Who controls the beaches around here?
faq.answer: Ratchet controls its harbor, while Southsea Freebooters camp along nearby beaches. The pirates disrupt trade, rob goblin convoys, and challenge Ratchet's authority.

angles.text: For the Horde, the Merchant Coast is the Barrens' chief commercial link to the sea. Securing Ratchet and suppressing local pirates matters to regional supply lines.
The Alliance keeps a naval presence at nearby Northwatch Hold. Its forces watch the goblin trade through Ratchet and the unruly Southsea pirates along the shore.
